training: Start with the frozen temporal-prefix direct allocation. For each outer held history H and each of the five remaining training histories J, fit the original direct raw, verified and within-history rotated contrast models using neither H nor J. On J measure the conditional relation-versus-activity gain of moving from the soft credit rule to an endpoint in the signed direction of credit-minus-raw score, retaining the same .20 native conditional contribution. A tied score within 1e-10 leaves the soft allocation unchanged. Weight windows equally within each donor history; gain is the actual whole-window relation-minus-activity F1 times the change in conditional probability. Set lambda = clip(mean gain / (mean absolute history gain + .005),0,1), independently for verified and rotated. Never fit lambda with later or target-history outcomes.
policy: Keep the temporal probability exactly as in the parent raw temporal allocation. Blend the parent's soft conditional policy with the indicated endpoint using the history-specific lambda. Report raw, soft, calibrated credit, its rotated analogue, full endpoint, uniformly split non-temporal mass, both parent margin allocations and native. Verify the raw and soft forecasts against the frozen parent on each target. Retain exact per-question direct-gain identity.
